title: OSIRIS
brief: An open-source Palantir alternative — track 10K+ aircraft, 2K satellites and worldwide CCTV on a 3D globe, and run Nmap, DNS, WHOIS and threat-intel scans from the browser across 20+ live feeds. Free.
details: OSIRIS (osirisai.live) is an open-source-intelligence platform with a striking mission-control interface — real-time global monitoring across flights, maritime traffic, satellites, CCTV, weather, and cyber threats. The v5.0 web app presents a dark global map with layer toggles (recon, space, markets, alerts, route search, ArcGIS), location hover, and keyboard shortcuts, styled like a secure terminal establishing its connection. A playground for OSINT-style visualization and live data layers rather than a documented API product — open it for the experience of a global intelligence dashboard in the browser.
